title: Serum EBI-3 Protein Levels in Behçet's Disease
off: Serum Epstein-Barr Virus-induced Gene 3 Protein Levels in Patients With Behçet's Disease

officials.a: Physical Medicine, Rheumatology and Rehabilitation Department, Assiut University Hospitals

summary: This cross-sectional study aims to evaluate serum Epstein-Barr virus-induced gene 3 (EBI-3) protein levels in patients with Behçet's disease compared with healthy controls.
desc:
Behçet's disease is a chronic multisystem inflammatory disorder. Serum EBI-3 protein levels may reflect inflammatory activity.

This observational study will include adult patients diagnosed with Behçet's disease according to the International Criteria for Behçet's Disease and age-matched healthy controls. Serum EBI-3 protein levels will be measured by ELISA.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \- Age 18 years or older
* Diagnosis of Behçet's disease according to the International Criteria for Behçet's Disease (cases)
* Healthy individuals without autoimmune or inflammatory diseases (controls)
* Written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* \- Other autoimmune disorders (RA, SLE, psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis)
* Acute or chronic infection
* Malignancy or history of malignancy
* Chronic liver disease or advanced chronic kidney disease
* Pregnancy or lactation
* Vasculitis caused by diseases other than Behçet's disease

arms.d: Patients diagnosed with Behçet's disease according to the International Criteria for Behçet's Disease.
Age-matched healthy individuals without autoimmune or inflammatory diseases.
